what: Every environment setting the released tool reads, in the three kinds of family rule 27, and the two-key test settings. The test test_G5_15_every_environment_read_is_on_one_list reads every environment read in scripts/tardigrade.py against these lists and fails on one that is in none, or on a name listed here that the code no longer reads.

person.name: TERMINAL
person.said: `open` says "Opening the windows with <terminal> (from TERMINAL)." when it chose the terminal

person.name: TMUX_TMPDIR
person.said: census says "tmux sockets are looked for in <folder> (from TMUX_TMPDIR ...)" when it chose the folder

host.name: HOME
host.read: where every file of Tardigrade's is
host.not_there: Python takes the home folder from the account database
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: USER
host.read: the account name for lingering, and sessions' USER and LOGNAME
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: SHELL
host.read: the shell sessions start in, when the shell setting is empty (bash or zsh only)
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: LANG
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: PATH
host.read: folders added after the default PATH of a tmux server it starts
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: TMPDIR
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
host.read: handed on to sessions; where systemctl --user finds the user's service manager
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: DISPLAY
host.read: whether there is a desktop for `open` and desktop notes
host.not_there: no desktop: `open` prints the attach line for each session
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

host.name: WAYLAND_DISPLAY
host.read: the same, for a Wayland desktop
host.could_not_be_read: the tool's own environment is always readable

markers_note: Tardigrade sets no environment marker of its own that it reads back.

test_two_key.name: TARDIGRADE_TESTING
test_two_key.note: the first key; the second is the file tardigrade-test-home that the test suite writes in its scratch home. The setting alone changes nothing, and the run's first line says it was found and ignored.
